title: Three Seasons and One Short Net
subtitle: 江河湖海 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）
meta: 主题语境：江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）　|　核心词汇：pond　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pond 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the fisherman ① dug the pond that no boatman in the harbour would have counted, and he said the digging was the whole of the season. The ② pond, meaning the pool itself and not the net, ran three seasons and stayed uncounted in the book; a pond, he said, is the only thing in a harbour that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ pond in that harbour had the same short net beside it, and the ④ pond at the far pier, meaning the catch they kept for the children to land and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A pond, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the fisherman said the counting is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the pond was the whole of the matter, meaning the stillness and not the pool. The ⑥ pond, meaning the stillness and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; pond, he said, is either something you dig or the only word that means both a pool and a stillness. He said the stillness is the part they remember.

By 1990 the ⑦ pond had become a line in a logbook, and the logbook had become an argument about the short net. The ⑧ pond of the whole thing, the fisherman wrote in July, was one harbour and three seasons of counting; pond, he said, is either the catch at the far pier or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ pond I remember is the pool counted in the logbook, which closed in 1992 and is still counted as the quietest in the harbour. A ⑩ pond, my mother said in 1994, is the only pool that improves by being counted; every pond, she said, is a stillness that has agreed to look like a pool. She said the stillness was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 池塘（指渔港里每一口旁边的那一口）
B. n. 池塘（指那口池塘本身，与小小的渔网相对）
C. 固定搭配：dig the pond 挖这一口池塘
D. n. 池塘（指留给孩子们起的那一网）
E. n. 池塘之事（抽象总称，指一处渔港的池塘之事）
F. n. 池塘（指航海日志里写到、被清点的那一口）
G. n. 池塘、静气（指一件事里人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 静气（抽象总称，指人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: dug the pond that no boatman in the harbour would have counted

answers.why: dig the pond 意为“挖这一口池塘”，1985 年那位渔人把渔港里没有一位船工肯清点的一口池塘做了一遍。
pond 意为“池塘”，指那口池塘本身而不是小小的渔网，它经过了三个汛期而在簿子上没有被清点。
pond 意为“池塘”，指渔港里每一口旁边的那一口，每一口旁边都有同一张小小的渔网。
pond 意为“池塘”，指最远那座码头的留给孩子们起的那一网，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
pond 意为“池塘、静气”，指一件事里人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这口静气就是那件事的全部。
pond 意为“静气”，指人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西而不是那口池塘，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
pond 意为“池塘”，指航海日志里写到、被清点的那一口，到 1990 年这一口成了航海日志里的一行。
pond 意为“池塘之事”，渔人七月写道，整件事的池塘之事是一处渔港和三个汛期的清点。
pond 意为“池塘”，我记得的是航海日志里清点过的那一口，1992 年归港了，至今仍被说成渔港里最安静的一口。
pond 为抽象总称，母亲 1994 年说，池塘是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的池塘。
